verdict.rationale: Google's docs explicitly state that regular Gemini Apps chats and uploaded files are not used to train models and are not reviewed by humans, while separately disclosing that Gemini Live audio/video can be used to improve/train models unless opted out, and users can manage/delete activity via My Activity controls. This gives knowledge-workers clear, documented control and visibility over training use. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that these settings are honored in practice, and clearer UI-level toggle documentation for the Live-specific training opt-out.
